# Simulate data

Dates

```{r}
options(scipen = 999)
set.seed(3111963)
# define N
n=1e6
# define start and end of registry
start_date=as.Date("2005-01-01")
end_date=as.Date("2022-12-31")
max_days=as.numeric(end_date - start_date)
# simulate dates
backward_days=rtruncexp(n=n,
                        rate=0.0002,
                        max=max_days)
# calculate onset date
onsetdatev=end_date-floor(backward_days)
```

Covariates

```{r}
set.seed(181299)
# baseline covs
covs=data.frame(id=1:n,
                dateonset=onsetdatev,
                aoo=runif(n,0,8),
                event=1,
                u=runif(n,0,1),
                e=rnorm(n,0.5,0.02),
                sex=sample(c('male','female'),n,replace=T)) %>% 
  mutate(male=as.integer(sex=="male"),
         trialdate=as.Date("2021-05-31"),
         post=dateonset>=trialdate)
```

# Tune

## Build filtered dataset

```{r}
# filter pre
prep_long = function(base, t_int, t_age, t_sex){
  base %>% 
    mutate(ptrt=plogis(t_int - t_age*aoo + t_sex*male),
           conf=u < ptrt,
           trt =as.integer(conf & post)) %>% 
    filter(!(post & !conf))   
# get smds
}
get_smds_long = function(base, t_int, t_age, t_sex){
  d = prep_long(base, t_int, t_age, t_sex)
  abs(c(smd::smd(d$aoo, d$trt)$estimate, smd::smd(d$male, d$trt)$estimate))
}
```

## Solve for the treatment parameters to get SMDs

```{r}
solve_treatment_long = function(base, target_smd_age, target_smd_sex, t_int=2, start=c(0.65, 2.2)){
  obj=function(par) sum((get_smds_long(base, t_int, par[1], par[2]) - c(target_smd_age, target_smd_sex))^2)
  o=optim(start, obj, method="Nelder-Mead", control=list(reltol=1e-10))
  c(t_age=o$par[1], t_sex=o$par[2])
}
```

## Solve for outcome parameters to get bias

```{r}
solve_outcome_long = function(d, target_bias, share_age=0.5, effect=0.10){
  diff_aoo =mean(d$aoo[d$trt==1])  - mean(d$aoo[d$trt==0])
  diff_male=mean(d$male[d$trt==1]) - mean(d$male[d$trt==0])
  c(b_age=share_age*target_bias*effect/diff_aoo,
    b_sex=(1-share_age)*target_bias*effect/diff_male,
    diff_aoo=diff_aoo, diff_male=diff_male)
}
```

## Get values given targets

```{r}
calibrate_long = function(base, target_smd_age, target_smd_sex, target_bias, t_int=-1, share_age=0.5){
  trt_par=solve_treatment_long(base, target_smd_age, target_smd_sex, t_int)
  d=prep_long(base, t_int, trt_par["t_age"], trt_par["t_sex"])
  out_par=solve_outcome_long(d, target_bias, share_age)
  list(parameters=c(t_int=t_int, trt_par, out_par[c("b_age","b_sex")]),
       achieved=c(get_smds_long(base, t_int, trt_par["t_age"], trt_par["t_sex"]),
                  bias=unname(out_par["b_age"]*out_par["diff_aoo"] + out_par["b_sex"]*out_par["diff_male"])/0.10),
       n_treated=table(d$trt))
}

calibrate_long(covs, target_smd_age=0.5, target_smd_sex=0.5, target_bias=-0.20)
```
